geopolitics_summary: EU-Russia oil sanctions negotiations stalled; Iran-US conflict disrupts Strait of Hormuz; France's nuclear capacity strained by extreme heat.

themes.headline: EU stalls Russia oil price cap sanctions; reconvenes next week
themes.why_it_matters: Delay in price cap ratchet risks crude spike, raising fuel-switching pressure into gas and power. TTF arb sensitive to Brent/WTI spreads and sanctioned crude availability.

themes.headline: France nuclear reactors shut by extreme heat amid rising demand
themes.why_it_matters: Heat-driven nuclear outages directly tighten French generation; forces substitution into gas and coal. Narrows continental supply and pushes DA/Cal spreads wider.

themes.headline: Strait of Hormuz conflict unresolved; Trump fee plan revoked then backtracked
themes.why_it_matters: Ongoing Strait disruptions constrain global crude and LNG. Higher Brent and reduced LNG arbitrage to Europe raise fuel costs and gas import scarcity premium via TTF.

themes.headline: Russia halts diesel exports after Ukraine refinery strikes
themes.why_it_matters: Russian diesel export collapse tightens global refined product; forces more gas substitution in industrial power generation. Fuels switching margin favors gas temporarily.

themes.headline: Global LNG trade hit record 56.3 Bcf/d in 2025; US capacity drives growth
themes.why_it_matters: Record US LNG exports improve European supply elasticity and reduce LNG spot premiums, easing TTF cost basis. Structural oversupply pressure on winter curve.

watchlist: EU Russia sanctions vote deadline end-July; oil price cap ratchet risk.
France nuclear reactor restart timeline; heat wave persistence in southern Europe.
Strait of Hormuz escalation; LNG shipping route disruption and Brent volatility.
Ukraine strikes on Russian fuel infrastructure impact on winter gas flows to Europe.
